summary.text: Jennifer Cassidy is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 32 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Michael Todd in a race with no incumbent.
She describes herself as a certified nursing assistant and small business owner from Grain Valley.

paragraphs.text: Jennifer Cassidy was born in Kansas City, Kansas, and graduated from Berean Christian School.
She attended Kansas University and graduated from the University of Missouri in 2026.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has lived in Grain Valley for more than 23 years, has worked as a caregiver in long-term care facilities and has volunteered for decades on behalf of homeless residents, seniors and people with disabilities.
In the survey, Cassidy said she would oppose data centers on agricultural land and in cities, support jobs in healthcare, education and the skilled trades, and protect Social Security and Medicare.
She listed endorsements from the League of Women Voters, the Abortion Action Committee, the AFL-CIO, Pipefitters 533 and IBEW 124.
